uutiset.s: Dennis Wilder, Senior Fellow at Georgetown University and former CIA Deputy Assistant Director for East Asia and the Pacific, says the trilateral meeting between US President Donald Trump, Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin is in itself sending a message. uutiset.t: RRJ-Led Consortium Buys Australia Coal Miner’s $619 Million Debt
uutiset.s: A consortium led by private investment firm RRJ Capital has agreed to buy $619 million of bonds from Australian coking coal miner GM3, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: India Studies Tax Proposals to Encourage Stock Trading, Curb Speculative Bets
uutiset.s: Investors and economists have proposed raising taxes on stock derivatives while lowering levies on share trading.

uutiset.t: K-Pop Giants Position for China Return After Decade-Long Freeze
uutiset.s: South Korean entertainment companies are positioning themselves for a return to China after the two countries agreed to expand cultural exchanges, raising hopes that Beijing may loosen restrictions that have kept major K-pop acts out of the mainland for almost a decade.

uutiset.t: A-Cap Insurer Asks to Defer Payouts to Clients Amid Deal Talks
uutiset.s: Advantage Capital Holdings’ main life insurer, which has been disputing a state regulator’s concerns about its financial strength, is seeking to defer certain payments to customers while pursuing sale talks with a potential acquirer.

uutiset.t: Australian Dollar Erases 2026 Gain as Rate-Cut Bets Increase
uutiset.s: Australia’s dollar wiped out its 2026 gain against the greenback after weak employment data reinforced bets that the central bank has ended its interest-rate hike cycle and will pivot to cuts next year.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Hands Korean Tycoon’s Firm $3 Billion Windfall
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster initial public offering has delivered a multibillion-dollar windfall for billionaire Chey Tae-won’s empire, rewarding an early bet on the artificial intelligence startup by SK Telecom Co., South Korea’s largest mobile carrier.

uutiset.t: LNG Exports Through Hormuz Appear to Slow After More Attacks
uutiset.s: The amount of liquefied natural gas tankers passing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz appears to have dropped over the last week, according to satellite and ship-tracking data, suggesting shipowners are being more cautious after a flurry of attacks.

uutiset.t: Copper Rebounds After Rout as Physical Tightness Persists
uutiset.s: Copper steadied after plunging almost 6% on Wednesday — the biggest drop since April 2025 — on a sharp unwinding of bullish bets tied to artificial intelligence and US tariffs.

uutiset.t: Morgan Stanley’s Hornbach Says Rogue AI Biggest Underpriced Risk
uutiset.s: Artificial intelligence can bring exponential benefits but the damage that may result from a breach of its safeguards is the biggest risk that’s being underpriced by markets right now, according to Morgan Stanley.

uutiset.t: China Markets $2 Billion of Dollar Bonds as Xi, Trump Meet
uutiset.s: China began marketing up to $2 billion of dollar-denominated sovereign bonds, as leaders of the world’s two largest economies are set to meet in Shenzhen.

uutiset.t: Blue Owl Plans $513 Million CMBS for Amazon-Leased Data Center
uutiset.s: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is preparing to sell $513 million of commercial mortgage backed securities to fund the acquisition of a Northern Virginia data center that’s fully leased to Amazon.com Inc., according to people with knowledge of the matter.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Prices at $83 a Share in Record-Sized Offering
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC and its co-founders raised $107.3 billion in an upsized IPO and private placement. The artificial intelligence firm sold 956.4 million shares and the co-founders sold 23.6 million shares for $83 each, according to a statement, above the marketed range. uutiset.t: Treasuries Draw Record Demand From South Korean Investors
uutiset.s: South Korean investors bought a record amount of US Treasuries in September, reversing heavy selling as yields climbed and buyers sought to diversify away from a chip-heavy local stock market.

uutiset.t: Jeffrey Sachs Expects Friendly Trilateral Outcome
uutiset.s: Columbia University Professor Jeffrey Sachs says he is happy that the leaders of US-China and Russia have agreed to have a trilateral meeting. Speaking to Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle, he adds that his expectations are that the outcome will be ‘calm’ and ‘friendly’. (Source: Bloomberg)
